method: 1) Searched Workable's public job-search JSON (the one jobs.workable.com itself uses: GET /api/v1/jobs?query=<keyword>&location=Saudi Arabia) with about 45 keywords across the six families, kept Saudi locations, filtered by title and by the experience line. 2) Probed the listed Saudi employers' own ATS boards: Workable accounts API, Greenhouse boards API, Lever postings API, Ashby posting API, SmartRecruiters postings API, plus several careers pages. 3) Opened every chosen posting on 20 Nov 2026 from the company's own board (apply.workable.com/<company>, Greenhouse, SmartRecruiters) or Workable's own job page (jobs.workable.com/view/... and its .md twin), and re-requested each final URL (all HTTP 200). 4) Evidence and bandEvidence strings were matched by script against each posting's text (markdown bold, bullets and stray links stripped), so they are verbatim. No aggregators (LinkedIn, Indeed, Bayt, etc.), no logins, no forms. Preferred direct employers; three postings come from recruitment/staffing firms' own Workable boards and are flagged in their notes (two in cyber, where no direct-employer posting at entry-mid level was found besides Qiddiya).
